g.title: cluster_S1
g.text: STAGE 1 · CAPTURE — in wf_TRS_Stage_Load_1_Ongoing, plus the History workflow

g.title: cluster_S2
g.text: STAGE 2 · COPY KEYS — the CopyList mappings (separate step, for re-runnability)

g.title: cluster_S3
g.text: STAGE 3 · ACT — command tasks (key logic in scripts outside IDQ)

g.title: cluster_S4
g.text: STAGE 4 · CLOSE — wf_TRS_Deactivation_Complete (runs after the MDM batch)

g.title: C1
g.text: keep only NEW rows (not already in the log)

g.title: DEL1
g.text: (update-strategy delete — member leaves the valid spine)

g.title: MP
g.text: log rows still at 'N' → set PROCESSED_YN = 'Y' (DD_UPDATE)

g.title: IND
g.text: on success, or when there was no data

g.title: ACT
g.text: MDM batch-group UNMERGE of the copied keys

g.title: BATCH
g.text: MDM batch applies the staged records
hub rows are SOFT-DELETED (state -1), not removed

g.title: MR
g.text: only keys whose xref group shows MAX(HUB_STATE_IND) = -1
